projects.projectName: Premera Blue Cross - Producer Portal Development - Phase 1

riskDescription.context: Scope changes are emerging from UX standpoint and business angle, and all scope is being triaged based on available bandwidth (EMS Scope RAG: Amber as of 2026-06-04).
riskDescription.condition: Additional scope requests may exceed available team capacity, leading to incomplete prioritization or deferred critical features.
riskDescription.consequence: Delivery timeline could slip, or essential functionality may be deprioritized, impacting client satisfaction and project outcomes.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish formal scope change evaluation and approval procedure with impact assessment before accepting new UX or business requests.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon scope exceeding available bandwidth, rebaseline impacted scope and delivery plan with Premera, prioritizing critical-path functionality and deferring non-essential features.
risks.reasoning: Scope Amber in EMS with ongoing UX and business-driven changes, constrained by bandwidth. Single-source EMS evidence with explicit bandwidth limitation.

riskDescription.context: AAVA connectivity from Development instance to Production instance is not established, limiting the capability to use AAVA fully for code and refactoring effort (EMS internal limitation, Timeline RAG: Amber as of 2026-06-04).
riskDescription.condition: Code refactoring and quality improvement activities may remain incomplete or delayed until production connectivity is secured.
riskDescription.consequence: Technical debt could accumulate, and deployment readiness may be compromised, increasing post-go-live defect risk.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Coordinate with Premera infrastructure team weekly to provide all requested details and expedite AAVA production instance connectivity approval.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If AAVA production connectivity is not established by 2026-07-01, escalate to Circle Head and Premera leadership, and implement manual code review checkpoints.
risks.reasoning: Active internal limitation documented in EMS with explicit impact on refactoring capability. Go-green plan confirms coordination in progress but no resolution date.

riskDescription.context: AAVA deployment does not feature logging and monitoring, and AAVA Team requires support from Premera to establish it (EMS internal gap, Timeline RAG: Amber as of 2026-06-04).
riskDescription.condition: Production issues may go undetected or take longer to diagnose without proper logging and monitoring in place.
riskDescription.consequence: Incident response time could increase, affecting system stability and client confidence in operational readiness.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Coordinate with Premera operations and AAVA teams bi-weekly to define and implement logging and monitoring setup on AAVA client instance.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If logging and monitoring are not operational by 2026-07-15, deploy manual log collection scripts and establish 24x7 on-call rotation for incident triage.
risks.reasoning: Internal gap in EMS requiring external Premera support. Go-green plan shows coordination underway but no confirmed setup date.

riskDescription.context: Dependency with Data Hub exists, and the current Data Model provided by PO as of 2026-06-03 is being used for development (EMS external dependency, Timeline RAG: Amber).
riskDescription.condition: Actual Data Hub APIs may differ from the baseline model, requiring rework and refactoring once real APIs are available.
riskDescription.consequence: Integration effort could increase late in the cycle, delaying testing and go-live readiness.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Baseline Data Model with PO and communicate clearly to Premera, creating new PBI for refactoring once actual Data Hub APIs are ready.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Once Data Hub API changes are confirmed, allocate dedicated sprint capacity for integration rework and notify Premera of revised integration testing timeline.
risks.reasoning: External dependency documented in EMS with baseline model in use. Go-green plan confirms new PBI for refactoring once actual APIs are ready, indicating expected rework.

riskDescription.context: Metrics are not available from AAVA to track actual progress gains using AAVA (EMS internal limitation as of 2026-06-04).
riskDescription.condition: Project leadership may lack visibility into AAVA-driven productivity improvements, making it difficult to assess ROI or adjust delivery plans.
riskDescription.consequence: Resource planning and forecasting accuracy could decline, and stakeholder confidence in tooling investment may weaken.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Implement weekly manual tracking of AAVA usage metrics and productivity gains, documenting in status reports to support data-driven resource planning.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If AAVA metrics remain unavailable by 2026-07-01, establish alternative velocity tracking using sprint burndown and story completion rates, and escalate to AAVA vendor.
risks.reasoning: Internal limitation in EMS affecting progress tracking. Single-source signal with moderate impact on governance and planning.

riskDescription.context: Citrix environment is experiencing slowness and frequent disconnection, impacting delivery (EMS Go Green Updates as of 2026-06-04).
riskDescription.condition: Developer productivity may continue to degrade if Citrix performance issues persist or escalate.
riskDescription.consequence: Sprint velocity could drop, and timeline commitments may be at risk despite Quality RAG being Green.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Raise priority ticket with Premera infrastructure team to resolve Citrix slowness and disconnection, tracking resolution progress in weekly status meetings.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If Citrix performance does not improve within two weeks, provide VDI support coverage during offshore hours and request alternative remote access solution from Premera.
risks.reasoning: Active infrastructure issue documented in EMS with planned ticket escalation to Premera. Quality RAG is Green, but delivery impact is noted.

riskDescription.context: Team size is 11 resources (10 offshore, 1 onshore) with ongoing scope changes and bandwidth constraints noted in EMS (Scope RAG: Amber, Talent RAG: Green as of 2026-06-04).
riskDescription.condition: If scope expansion continues or key resources become unavailable, the team may lack sufficient capacity to absorb additional work.
riskDescription.consequence: Delivery commitments could be missed, or quality may decline due to overallocation and fatigue.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Monitor team capacity weekly against sprint commitments and scope changes, adjusting release scope proactively to protect delivery quality and timelines.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should team capacity fall below 80 percent due to attrition or scope overload, request additional offshore resources from Circle Head within five business days.
risks.reasoning: Bandwidth constraint explicitly mentioned in EMS Scope RAG reason. Talent RAG is Green, but scope pressure and small team size create capacity risk.
